extracted.name: Shredded Brussels Sprouts
extracted.description: This easy Shredded Brussels Sprouts recipe is my absolute favorite side dish! I love how it's a simple side that only takes 10 minutes to make and is absolutely delicious!
ingredient_lines: salt and freshly ground black pepper (, to taste)
instruction_lines: Use a food processor or sharp knife to thinly chop/shred the Brussels Sprouts.

Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium high heat. Add Brussels sprouts, season with salt and pepper, and sauté for a few minutes, stirring only occasionally to allow them to crisp a little. Add garlic then cook for 30 seconds.
Drizzle a little water over the top to steam them a little (cooks them quicker), stir and continue to cook until tender.
